contracts.finding: Observation identity is one fixed-clock interval/side slot. Continuity is segment bookkeeping, not persistent structural-object identity.
Persistence counters require contiguous scope and reset on gaps/axis changes; the policy does not grant a persistent referent identity across changing C2 structural definitions.

Level definitions are immutable. Level identity includes value, first-valid time, source IDs and other provenance; a changed anchor or source population creates a new level identity. The contract contains a working disposition that trailing-range lineage persists while the same anchor persists, but this is lineage/snapshot semantics rather than an explicit IAD persistent-referent identity.

TRAILING_RANGE_SNAPSHOT is bound to one exact causal population. Container identity changes with boundary IDs, first-valid time, horizon or other constitutive fields; no persistent referent across snapshot refresh is declared.

Temporal relation delta/crossing requires one unchanged immutable object identity. Reference identity change is explicitly not same-object crossing; the relation layer does not infer a persistent identity across changed object IDs.
C2E frame identity is observation/C2-record scoped. Episode/context lineage is not a persistent-object ground truth for IAD.
C2P may read exact upstream facts but may not reconstruct absent upstream structure; upstream identity is immutable to C2P.
Only C2PObjectAssertion is durable identity in the current C2P core; StructuralReferent is deferred. ObjectAssertion cannot serve as candidate-independent owner ground truth for A/B/C.

implementation_observations.finding: Trailing HIGH/LOW lineage_id is deterministically based on horizon/type/anchor observation/side/clock; midpoint lineage is derived from high+low lineages. Each snapshot level still receives a new immutable level_id because first-valid time and source population participate in definition identity.
Full C2 level records preserve lineage_id and source_ids before downstream projection.

Frozen RS0 C2 source rows project level_id/container_id plus geometry/topology but omit level lineage_id, source_ids, anchor observation identity and boundary-lineage identity. The omitted owner evidence cannot be reconstructed by C2P under the producer-consumer contract.
